s11.q1: What is an enterprise AI agent?
s11.a1: It is an artificial intelligence configured to act in real functions of your company — sales, service, management, leadership or executive support. It operates as a digital employee that responds via text and humanized audio, 24/7, focused on productivity and results.
s11.q2: What is the difference between the 3 agents?
s11.a2: The Sales Accelerator Agent handles sales, marketing, service and relationships. The Leadership & Management Agent supports managers with metrics, projects and coordination. The Executive Director Agent offers high-level strategic consulting for the C-suite.
s11.q3: Do I need IT or technical knowledge?
